item.tib: 'jigs byed gshin rje gshin nag gi dgongs gsol las bzhi myur 'grub
item.coloph: 'jigs byed gshin nag gi dgongs gsol las bzhi myur 'grub 'di/ bsdoms (sdom) brtson sde 'dzin pa tshul mi shel bzhin sogs/ nye gnas 'ga' yis bskul phyir snyigs dus kyi dka' thub me ston nyi ri wer zhi'i (zhis) 'dus gnas rin chen 'bar ba'i yang dben mthong grol khrod du sbyar ba'o//
